edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Titan's Wrath banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Rocket Grab (Q) is 20s at rank 1, 16s at max — punish the miss window hard. Power Fist (E) resets on 7-5s and opens with an auto wind-up, not the cast. Static Field (R) charges 60-20s and silences on activation — bait it before you all-in.
